adjudication.rationale:
In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration builds raw SQL with string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`. This does not escape quotes, so a host value containing `'` will produce invalid SQL (or worse). Also `val.split("
")` will include empty strings for blank lines (e.g. "a.com

b.com" => ["a.com", "", "b.com"]) and the migration will insert `host=''` rows, bypassing the model’s `validates_format_of` since it uses direct SQL inserts.
